name: Salbutamol
halfLifeSource: FDA label for Albuterol Sulfate Inhalation Aerosol (albuterol sulfate), Clinical Pharmacology 12.2 — terminal t½ ≈ 6 hours
halfLifeNotes: Terminal plasma half-life ~6 h in healthy adults after oral inhalation of racemic albuterol (= salbutamol); the DrugBank hint of 3.3–4 h traces to levalbuterol, a different product, so the racemic-albuterol label wins.
